reference_source: Existing original project sprites and the project's darker Warden style reference.

ranger.initial: Use case: style-transfer. Image 1 identity reference dark olive hooded masked ranger, longbow and quiver, leather armor, tiny lime bow charm; image 2 Warden style reference. ONE character pose sheet, exactly 3 columns by 2 rows, six equally sized cells. Reading order: TOP LEFT idle ready facing RIGHT; TOP MIDDLE bow release facing RIGHT; TOP RIGHT a magical arrow prepared with a small lime glow facing RIGHT; BOTTOM LEFT bow held across chest defending facing RIGHT; BOTTOM MIDDLE hurt recoil facing RIGHT; BOTTOM RIGHT relaxed second idle facing RIGHT. Same full-body character identity, equipment and scale in EVERY cell. Each figure fits entirely within its own cell with generous transparent margins and no crossing cell boundaries. Match Warden's very bold thick black ink contours, simplified angular shapes, broad flat black shadows, charcoal/dark muted colors, narrow bone highlights, tiny bright accent. Dark gothic graphic 2D RPG illustration, no realistic microtexture. All feet and weapons visible; real transparent background, no text/grid/ground/shadows. Original character designs.
ranger.spacing_correction: Edit this sprite sheet preserving all six exact character designs and poses. Fix spacing for reliable game atlas extraction. Exactly THREE equal-width columns and TWO equal-height rows: idle, attack, casting above; guard, hurt, alternate idle below. Every pose must fit ENTIRELY inside its own cell including all weapons, magic and cloak, with at least 12% fully transparent empty margin on every side of each cell. Make character bodies smaller if necessary. No characters or weapons crossing cell boundaries, no clipped extremities. Same body scale in every cell. Keep dark ink look and tiny accents. Remove all diffuse background aura/brown vignette. Real transparent alpha, isolated ink silhouettes and controlled tiny magic accents only. No text or drawn grid.

walk.warden: Use case: stylized-concept. Supplied warden walking sheet is identity and equipment reference. Create a NEW four-frame WALK CYCLE sheet, exactly TWO columns and TWO rows, equal quadrants, reading order clockwise? IMPORTANT reading order row major: top left 1, top right 2, bottom left 3, bottom right 4. ALL figures side-view facing RIGHT. Frame1 near leg extended FORWARD heel down and far leg BACK; frame2 near leg bends underneath hip passing forward, feet close; frame3 near leg extended BACK and far leg FORWARD, opposite of frame1; frame4 far leg bends beneath hip passing, opposite of frame2. Clearly DIFFERENT LEG positions, cloak follows stride, slight opposed arm swings while retaining same equipment. Same character proportions, head height, scale and ground baseline within each quadrant. Entire boots/weapons stay inside each quadrant with 8% margins and transparent gutters. Thick bold black gothic ink contours, dark simplified angular flat shadows, muted colors and tiny bright class accent. Preserve original character costume. Four full-body figures, no text/numbers/grid/ground/shadows, real transparent background.
